portable_wasm.method: Node WebAssembly elapsed time includes evaluation and JSON serialization. Gzip bytes are the sum of per-file compressed sizes for the complete build. Process RSS includes Node.

baseline_portable_wasm.method: Node WebAssembly elapsed time includes evaluation and JSON serialization. Gzip bytes are the sum of per-file compressed sizes for the complete build. Process RSS includes Node.

comparison_0_1_1.scope: Same Windows machine and native counter definitions. The baseline and revision had different phase durations and calculation mixes. ABBA compares two profiles on the same 0.2.0 app instance. Independent Node WASM microbenchmarks use the same scripted workload.

workload.workload: Alternating exact arithmetic and compound expressions with irrational relative percentages.

same_protocol_repeat_0_2_0.limitation: One same-protocol repeat and historical baseline under the default profile of each build. Different application versions and ordinary OS cache and background behavior remain observational.

limitations: The resident private set, private commit and global physical delta measure distinct quantities.
Shared pages can be attributed to several processes. The machine delta includes concurrent activity and is not an isolation guarantee.
WebView2 descendants include the browser, renderer and utility processes. Process totals cannot isolate WebView2 cache ownership from allocator retention.
The renderer heap comes from CDP and the WASM reading is linear memory capacity. Neither identifies physical resident pages.
A shorter repeated test can show recovery and any observed drift. It cannot establish absence of leaks over arbitrary durations.
Fresh profiles and reused profiles ran during the same boot with ordinary OS caches. The 100 MB incremental target remains a future engineering target.

interaction_boundary_probe.method: Real WebView2, DOM button handler to checked display mutation. Input injection, actionability and CDP round trips are excluded. The 0.1.1 pre-navy build is a nearby development reference, separate from the approved benchmark binary.
